If anyone heads for Cold Ocean, tell them: Bring a boat and do not swim for pride. I will be at the bell.
Gray waves make distance feel heavier. I'll remember that from near the bell.
Cold Ocean is no small story. Running the wrong way is still running.
I will remember Cold Ocean as water that chills courage out of the bones. I will stay where I can hear the bell.
